value.message: Kids & Me drop-in groups are free for babies up to age 6: Thursdays 10:30am-12pm at Acton library and Tuesdays 9:30-11am at St. Andrew's United in Georgetown - Halton Region's listing says, starting the second week of September. Links2Care's EarlyON centres in Acton and Georgetown are free too, but I could not get into their page today for the days or times.
